title-group.article-title: Fictional widget signalling in a fictional cohort

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: Fictional widgets are poorly understood. Earlier fictional work used the Oxford criteria in the introduction only.

sec.title: Participants
sec.p: Forty fictional patients were recruited from a fictional clinic. All met the Fukuda criteria (Fukuda et al., 1994) for fictional fatigue syndrome. Controls were matched for age.

sec.title: Assay
sec.p: Widget signalling was measured twice, one week apart.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: Patients showed lower widget signalling than controls.
